messages.subject: Bismark Sorted sam problem

messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Bismark Sorted sam problem
parts:
Keeping scaffolds or should be your choice! MethylKit doesn't discriminate if it is from scaffold or chromosome. All it needs is a name starting with 'Chr'

Regards,
Kalyan
On 19 September 2014 11:04, raza rahman <raza9p...@gmail.com> wrote:

thanks a lot. One more thing I want to ask weather it is better to delete scaffolds from the sam file for methylkit, or it does not matter?

On Thursday, September 18, 2014 7:11:00 PM UTC+2, Kalyan Kumar Pasumarthy wrote:
I always had them in numeric order (1,2,3..)! But the easiest thing for you is to try it out and see!

Regards,
Kalyan

 


On 18 September 2014 17:08, raza rahman <raza9p...@gmail.com> wrote:
Thank for the reply. Yes I will add chr to chromosomes after sorting them out. I wanted to know my chromosome order in sorted sam file is chr1,chr10,chr11,chr12,.....chr2,chr21,chr22..chr3,.... chrX,chrY

Is it what the methyl-kit accepts?

or should I have
chr1,chr2,chr3....chr9,chr10,chr11....chrX,chrY

I am sorting it as I used Bismark tool.

thanks

On Thursday, September 18, 2014 10:32:23 AM UTC+2, Kalyan Kumar Pasumarthy wrote:
Hi,

MethylKit does not work as expected if your chromosomes doesnot start with "Chr". I am afraid if you could proceed with these names!

Regards,
Kalyan

In the documentation they have mentioned

"SAM files must be sorted by chromosome and read position columns, using 'sort' command in unix-like machines will accomplish such a sort easily".

So I think we should sort on both rather than only on chromosomal coordinates.

sort -snk3 -k4 Sample_bismark_bt2_pe.sam > sorted_Sample_bismark_bt2_pe.sam
